model.title: Local Communities & Bird Habitat Stewardship Act of 2026
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Debbie Dingell (D-MI)

summary.text: The bill would establish a formal program within the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service to help communities protect and manage bird populations in cities and along migration routes. It would authorize grants—distributed through the National Fish and Wildlife Foundation—to government agencies, nonprofits, and academic institutions to support local bird conservation and habitat management efforts.
